name: Bootstrap
tagline: Rapid mission scaffolding with precision utility engineering.
timeTravelLog: Originally created at Twitter in 2011, Bootstrap became the most-used open-source CSS framework ever. Bootstrap 5 dropped jQuery dependency, making it lighter and faster than ever.
overview: Bootstrap 5 is a powerful, mobile-first CSS framework providing a responsive grid, pre-styled components, and utility classes. It enables rapid UI construction without writing extensive custom CSS.

syllabus.title: Module 1: CDN Setup & Utility Philosophy
syllabus.desc: Adding Bootstrap to a project and understanding the utility-first mindset.
syllabus.content: Bootstrap can be added via CDN link tags in the HTML head — no build tools required. Its utility classes apply single CSS properties directly in HTML: mt-3 adds margin-top, p-4 adds padding, text-center centers text. This eliminates repetitive CSS for common styling patterns.
syllabus.codeExample: Mission Control Interface
syllabus.interactiveTip: Bootstrap 5 removed jQuery as a dependency — the bundle.min.js includes Popper.js for dropdowns and tooltips. Always use bootstrap.bundle.min.js, NOT bootstrap.min.js alone!

syllabus.title: Module 2: Responsive Grid (Containers, Rows, Cols)
syllabus.desc: Building adaptive 12-column layouts that reflow across all screen sizes.
syllabus.content: Bootstrap's 12-column grid uses container > row > col structure. Column classes specify how many of the 12 columns an element should span: col-6 = 50% width. Breakpoint prefixes make columns responsive: col-sm-6 col-md-4 col-lg-3 — each breakpoint applies from that size upward.
syllabus.codeExample:
Alpha Sector
Beta Sector
Gamma Sector
syllabus.interactiveTip: The g-3 class on the row sets a gutter (gap) between columns — g-1 through g-5. This replaces the old padding-based gutter method and applies both horizontal and vertical gutters!

syllabus.title: Module 3: Components (Cards, Badges, Alerts, Buttons)
syllabus.desc: Using Bootstrap's pre-built UI components to build interfaces instantly.
syllabus.content: Bootstrap ships dozens of pre-styled components. Cards provide flexible content containers. Badges display status indicators. Alerts show dismissible notification bars. Buttons come in 8 semantic color variants with filled, outlined, and link styles. All components are mobile-ready and accessible out of the box.
syllabus.codeExample:
Sector 7 ONLINE

Deep space telemetry active.

View Data
Fuel reserves at 15% — initiate refuel protocol!
syllabus.interactiveTip: Bootstrap buttons accept block-level display using the d-grid class on the parent: <div class="d-grid"><button class="btn btn-primary"> — this is the Bootstrap 5 way of creating full-width buttons!

syllabus.title: Module 4: Navbar & Navigation
syllabus.desc: Building responsive navigation bars that collapse gracefully on mobile.
syllabus.content: Bootstrap's navbar component creates a fully responsive navigation system. The navbar-toggler button is shown on mobile and triggers the collapsible menu via data-bs-toggle. Use navbar-expand-{breakpoint} to control when the menu collapses. Supports dropdowns, brand logos, and form controls inline.
syllabus.codeExample:
JES-007
  • Home
  • Skills
  • Contact
syllabus.interactiveTip: The data-bs-toggle and data-bs-target attributes are Bootstrap's JavaScript attribute API — they wire interactive behavior without writing any JavaScript code yourself!

syllabus.title: Module 5: Modals, Dropdowns & Offcanvas
syllabus.desc: Adding interactive overlay components using Bootstrap's JavaScript data API.
syllabus.content: Modals create dialog overlays. Dropdowns create togglable menus. Offcanvas creates side panels that slide in from any edge. All are activated via data attributes (data-bs-toggle) without writing JavaScript. Bootstrap's JavaScript library handles the toggle logic, animation, backdrop, and keyboard escape automatically.
syllabus.codeExample:
Mission: Helios
Classified coordinates: 9.93°N, 76.26°E
syllabus.interactiveTip: Bootstrap modals can be controlled via JavaScript: const modal = new bootstrap.Modal('#missionModal'); modal.show(); — useful when you need to trigger modals programmatically after an API call!

syllabus.title: Module 6: Flexbox & Spacing Utilities
syllabus.desc: Fine-tuning layout, alignment, and spacing using Bootstrap's utility vocabulary.
syllabus.content: Bootstrap exposes full Flexbox control via utility classes: d-flex, justify-content-{value}, align-items-{value}, flex-column, gap-{n}. Spacing utilities follow the pattern {property}{sides}-{size}: mt-3 (margin top), px-4 (padding x-axis), ms-auto (margin-start auto to push elements right).
syllabus.codeExample:
ALPHA BETA GAMMA
Mission Status ONLINE
syllabus.interactiveTip: ms-auto (margin-start: auto) pushes a flex item to the far right of the container. It is Bootstrap's replacement for float: right — modern, predictable, and side-effect free!

syllabus.title: Module 7: Dark Mode & Custom Theming (Bootstrap 5.3+)
syllabus.desc: Enabling built-in dark mode and customizing Bootstrap design tokens.
syllabus.content: Bootstrap 5.3 introduced a native color mode system. Setting data-bs-theme="dark" on <html> or any parent element switches the entire UI to dark mode automatically. Custom themes override Sass variables before compilation, or CSS custom properties at runtime for zero-build customization.
syllabus.interactiveTip: Bootstrap 5.3's CSS variable overrides work without Sass — set --bs-primary at the :root level in your stylesheet to change the primary color across all components site-wide!

quiz.question: What does the Bootstrap class 'mt-4' apply?
quiz.explanation: Bootstrap spacing utilities follow the pattern {property}{sides}-{size}. 'm' = margin, 't' = top, '4' = spacing scale 4 (which is 1.5rem by default in Bootstrap's $spacer scale).

quiz.question: How do you make a Bootstrap 5 navbar collapse on mobile?
options: Add a CSS @media query to hide nav items below 768px
Use navbar-collapse class with data-bs-toggle on the toggler button
Import a separate mobile.css from the CDN
quiz.explanation: Bootstrap's collapse functionality is driven by the data-bs-toggle and data-bs-target attributes — no custom JavaScript needed. The navbar-expand-{breakpoint} class controls when the collapse triggers.

quiz.question: Which Bootstrap 5.3+ attribute enables dark mode for the entire page?
quiz.explanation: Bootstrap 5.3 introduced a native color mode system. data-bs-theme="dark" on the <html> tag (or any parent container) activates dark mode styles across all Bootstrap components within that scope.

quest.title: Quest: Code the Mission Control Interface
quest.challenge: Build a responsive Bootstrap 5 dashboard with a navbar, hero section, and a 3-column card grid.
instructions: 1. Add Bootstrap 5 CDN links to an HTML file and enable dark mode with data-bs-theme="dark".
2. Create a navbar with brand name and 3 nav links that collapse on mobile.
3. Add a full-width hero section using jumbotron-style utilities (text-center, py-5, bg-dark).
4. Create a container with 6 mission cards in a responsive 3-column grid (col-12 col-sm-6 col-lg-4).
5. Each card must have a title, status badge (bg-success or bg-warning), and an outline button.
